page.layout: One printed page: a woodcut ornament band at the top; then centred poems and signatures in the upper half, a rule, a second poem with signature; catchword at lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: Ad Auctorem Collegam & Amicum.

p.i: INgeniis nil maius: & his lucem atq; decorem
Addere quisquis amat, laude vehendus erit.
Gratu animi signum est merita aeternare Virorum,
Quod facis hic aliis, alii facient TIBI: claros
Inter clarus eris, CLARE MAGIRE, Viros.

main_text.p: Gregorius Francus S. Th. D. & Senior Facult. Theol.
main_text.head: Ad Lectorem.
main_text.p: Abbathum ut extaret Christianum, prima MAGIRO Cura erat, antiquae religionis opus, Gratum sacrorum mystis: Polymnemona Musis Multisciae hinc voluit condere mentis opus; Magna haec post gratae commendat Nomina famae, Profecisse olim queis sibi dulce fuit: Candidus atq; aliis monstrat. Gratum anne MAGIRVM, An doctum magis, an dixeris esse pium?
M. FRIDERICUS REICHELIUS Ling. Sanctae Prof. P. in Electorali Viadrina.

page.notes: Ornament band and rule are not text. Initial S and I are large woodcut-style letters. Some words in the first poem are set in italic and black-letter-like forms; transcribed as best read. Signature mark ")(()( 2" transcribed as printed.
